informational: The direct-tier gate escalates to FULL for any branch that regenerates crates/math/src/coeffs/tables.rs (generated source), so every fast-tier story gates FULL; a table-aware tier (the tests that include the changed table) would keep these gates short.

dd::two_prod (Dekker) overflows for an operand of 2^997 or more; any double-double code feeding it huge values gets NaN (here Hankel's 1/x and y1's (2/pi)/x). An FMA kernel (two_prod_fma, D-10.25 dispatch) has no such limit and is much cheaper.
improvement: Print each fallback operand in every fast-tier rate test (as fast_special does): it turned an undiagnosed 4e-4 into one region in one run; and sample each kernel up to f64::MAX, not 2^1000.
